operator_actions: automated browser simulation, not a personal builder review

chapters.name: Dispatch desk
chapters.text:
Automated replay walkthrough. Synthetic deliveries and simulated dispatcher actions.
This captioned recording is silent; live model results are reported separately.

chapters.name: Review cancellation
chapters.text:
A driver cancelled before pickup. The parcel is still at the depot.
No replacement courier is assigned yet.

chapters.name: Investigate and inspect facts
chapters.text:
Investigation retrieves order, couriers, quotes, policy and events.
Review the recorded courier, price, arrival estimate and quote expiry.

chapters.name: Evidence and approval boundary
chapters.text:
The explanation cannot grant authority. Versioned records support the proposal.
The dispatcher must approve this specific plan before assignment.

chapters.name: Unapproved commit blocked
chapters.text:
A direct backend commit without approval is rejected.
The screen still awaits approval; no assignment exists.

chapters.name: Approve one assignment
chapters.text:
Approval creates one simulated courier assignment.
Assignment is distinct from pickup and delivery.

chapters.name: Restart and repeat
chapters.text:
The server restarts with the same private runtime storage.
The same assignment survives; a repeated request does not book again.

chapters.name: Simulated pickup
chapters.text:
Simulated pickup changes custody to in transit.
The delivery is still incomplete.

chapters.name: Simulated delivery and history
chapters.text:
Simulated delivery releases reserved capacity.
History separates proposal, approval, assignment, pickup and delivery.

chapters.name: Safe infeasible escalation
chapters.text:
The second incident has no quote within its spending limit.
Replay escalates for manual review; it does not force a booking.

chapters.name: Portfolio evidence
chapters.text:
Replay is deterministic. Actual free-model results retain their failures.
Tests, source hashes and evidence are saved; personal builder review remains separate.

checks: Unapproved commit denied with valid authenticated request
Restart and repeat preserve identity and counts
limitations: Paced actual local-browser screen recording; action/setup gaps excluded from chapter pacing, not a latency benchmark.
No narrated builder voice or personal engineering-review attribution.
Replay outcome is separate from real-model performance and its preserved failures.
